name: Kaal Corpus Entity Index
description: Concept-level nodes over the claim layer. Every claim record carries an `about` array of concept slugs; this index resolves them. A node with status 'adjudicated' carries one ruled definition, its necessary conditions, a first-appearance citation with the basis for the priority call, the registers the term is used in, and its boundary cases. A node with status 'derived' is a mechanical roster of the claims carrying the slug and asserts no definition. Cite the adjudicated definition; for a derived node, cite the underlying claims. Claim status from claims/status.json is carried through: any claim that is superseded, falsified, or narrowed is flagged wherever a node lists it, and `non_current_claims` counts them per node.
singletons_note: 4379 concept slugs appear on exactly one claim. They get no node; each resolves to its single claim below.

entities.name: Reputation staking
entities.definition: Placing earned, non-transferable reputation at risk on a decision, where the amount staked both weights influence and can be lost.
